# scon_gateway_domain (Resource)

The gateway_domain records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Trimmed and lowercased
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references

### Optional

- `cert_file` (String)
- `certificate_id` (String)
- `key_file` (String)
- `rate_rps` (Number) 50 when zero or less
